records: The Binance SAFU BTC wallet balance and transaction history are one third-party explorer observation; no outgoing transaction after 2024-04-18 is shown, but Binance's stated 24-hour deployment window had not expired at the 2026-10-31T16:45Z cutoff and deployment may occur elsewhere or off-chain. Binance Futures Insurance Fund balances from SwoleCharts are third-party aggregate estimates; the Binance XRPUSDT pool is shared across ten symbols, and the Bybit XRPUSD isolated pool is a separate venue. ADGM's register verifies Nest Clearing and Custody's legal status but not the amount or segregation of SAFU capital. No directional XRP feature or forecast is admitted.
